subject: Her confession about this app changed everything
preview_text: She almost deleted Red Flag Scanner AI on day 1. What she discovered by day 30 will make you rethink everything.
body_paragraphs: Sarah almost deleted the app after the first scan. Said it was 'paranoid' and 'looking for problems.' She told me she felt guilty even having it on her phone. Then something shifted in week two.

She started noticing patterns she'd been brushing off for months. The 'jokes' that weren't funny. The apologies that always came with conditions. By day 30, she had scanned 47 conversations. The toxicity score told one story, but her gut finally had the evidence to speak up. She ended things last Tuesday. Said it was the cleanest breakup she's ever had because she could finally see clearly.

That pattern detection feature she almost ignored? It connected dots across months of texts. Showed her how certain phrases only appeared after fights. How compliments were always followed by requests. The dashboard didn't just show red flags—it showed the entire map of the relationship.

Open the app right now and check your relationship dashboard. Look at the timeline view. See if those 'isolated incidents' are actually connected. P.S. Sarah asked me to tell you this: 'The app doesn't create problems. It just stops you from explaining them away.'
